ns2:section.sectionText: This course is focused on the process of crafting a solution and evaluation plan related to a specific global health problem identified by students. Focuses on the process of crafting a solution and evaluation plan related to a specific global health problem identified by students. Requires students to work in teams to integrate content learning on global health with applied project design skills developed in this course. GLBL 440 fulfills a core requirement in completion of the Global Health Certificate. Pre-Req: GLBL 340 or consent of instructor.
